head: Sparkler Cake Candles
for Happy Celebrations
hero.sub: Set of 6 candles, 12, 20 or 25 cm long

feat.title: Sparkle on Cakes and Sweets
feat.sub: Coloured candles in 12, 20 or 25 cm, your choice
feats: Push them into the cake and light

steps.title: How to Use in 3 Steps
steps: Push the base firmly into the cake
Light the top with a long lighter, step back
Keep a safe distance while they sparkle

uses.title: For All Your Sweet Celebrations
uses.sub: For cakes and sweets at parties, weddings and occasions
uses.note: To be lit by an adult only, with a safe distance
